final_topology.title: Government Data Center Topology
final_topology.description: A secure and compliant data center design with isolated zones for public services, development, and production systems.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a DMZ for public-facing services, isolated zones for development and production, and a disaster recovery site. All network activity is logged for compliance.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n21) that collects and distributes inventory data to various nodes, indicating a detailed and maintained asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n22) that collects and distributes flow data to various nodes, indicating documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes isolated zones for 'Development Zone' (z2), 'Production Zone' (z3), and 'Disaster Recovery Site' (z4), indicating proper segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n_new1, n_new2, n_new3) specifically for the 'Development Servers' (z2), 'Production Servers' (z3), and 'Disaster Recovery Servers' (z4).

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n12) in the 'Management Zone' (z5) and data flows to various nodes, indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n23) and a 'Remote Access VPN' (n24) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n13) in the 'Security Zone' (z6) and data flows to the 'SIEM' (n4), indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n14) in the 'Security Zone' (z6) and data flows to the 'SIEM' (n4), indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes isolated zones for different functions (DMZ, Development, Production, Disaster Recovery, Management, Security, External Testing, Compliance) and various security controls, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Core Router' (n11) and 'Identity Server' (n5) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), and data flows for management traffic, indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n5) and 'Access Control Policy Manager' (n25) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN' (n24) and 'Bastion Host' (n10) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n16) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' (n9) in the 'Security Zone' (z6) and data flows to the 'SIEM' (n4), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes zone links (zl1, zl2, etc.) that indicate traffic filtering between different network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control Policy Manager' (n25) and 'Remote Access VPN' (n24) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), indicating managed access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n22) that collects and distributes flow data to various nodes, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIPS' (n17) in the 'Security Zone' (z6) and data flows to the 'SIEM' (n4), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' (n18) in the 'Security Zone' (z6) and data flows to the 'SIEM' (n4), indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n19) in the 'Security Zone' (z6) and data flows to the 'SIEM' (n4), indicating the performance of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes isolated zones for 'Development Zone' (z2) and 'Production Zone' (z3), indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' (n20) and 'Pen Test Scheduler' (n26) in the 'External Testing Zone' (z7), indicating the performance of periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show an asset inventory system or process. However, the presence of various nodes and zones suggests that an inventory might exist.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes data flow links, but there is no explicit documentation of these flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an identity server (n5) in the Management Zone, which could support MFA, but there is no explicit evidence of MFA being required.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of MFA requirement.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a label or node indicating MFA is required for remote access.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a bastion host (n10) and an identity server (n5), which could support remote access via a VPN, but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links to relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a bastion host (n10) and an identity server (n5), which could support access control for remote assets, but there is no explicit evidence of access control policies.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control policies.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating access control policies for remote assets.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a penetration testing host (n20) in the External Testing Zone, which suggests the capability for external penetration testing, but there is no explicit evidence of periodic testing.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration testing.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating periodic external penetration testing.

findings_before.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show firewalls implemented on servers. Only a general firewall (n1) is present in the DMZ.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add firewalls to specific server nodes (n6, n7, n8).
